# Frozen GitlabWorkSpace 0.24.1 predecessor

The installer comes from the committed v0.24.1 tag. The TAR.XZ contains the exact
manifest and payload of the official gitlab-workspace-kit-0.24.1.zip asset,
SHA-256 `88a3cbcf96f80ff82b387e649b78d8a6f22317b2867daa8de1c2f02ef132d3da`.

Tests install both original profiles, upgrade to the current package and verify
that rollback restores the original installed bytes. No user data is included.
